verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say every movement of funds into or out of a financial account creates a Transaction object that serves as a ledger entry for reconciliation. They also document a v2.money_management.transaction.created webhook event, so an event-driven mirror is partly supported. The evidence shows only a creation event, and nothing about how balances reflect holds or pending activity. Missing for 10: balance reads that break out holds and pending amounts, webhooks for every transaction state change (posted, voided, returned), and independent or hands-on confirmation of real-time accuracy.
